kind: code (tier A; residual-risk lens at phase gate — the out-of-repo quarantine lifecycle is one of the plan's four expected-broken mechanisms, prompt §8.2: extra red-step scrutiny + witness files). Includes adapter/quarantine.ts (prompt §3.3). Subagents read §2.1 itemTest rules (478-635), §2.6.1 (817-851), §4.2 (1544-1618), §4.3 (1619-1635).

assertions.text: runTest derives command from scope's itemTest template (§2.1 substitutions {files} {dirs} {name}); zero-test guard: a targeted run that executed no tests is neither red nor pass — falls back
no template (or guard fired) => full scope command under §4.2 quarantine, record marked targeted:false; illegal-red rule: failure excerpt must name a testScope file

classification via core.classifyFailure with item fileScope; per-runner unresolved-specifier extraction rules are DATA (table), not code; end-to-end: import of not-yet-existing module inside fileScope => missing-subject legal red; outside => error
runVerify: quarantine FIRST, then start-stamp, then HEAD/branch record, then run; build-before-test per scope; timeout kills; runs in cwd
excludeTestFiles moved to <stateHome>/conductor/<workspaceKey>/quarantine/<runId>/ OUTSIDE the repo before start-stamp; restored after; quarantined red file provably not executed (witness file)
manifest replays pending restores after a mid-verify kill (next run heals)
quarantined file's mtime survives the round-trip (rename, not copy — else every quarantine invalidates freshness)
verify-running-<treeKey>.json {pid,startMs} created/removed; second runVerify against LIVE marker for same tree returns refusal record; stale marker (dead pid) broken with anomaly
build-fail => test provably not run (witness file); start-stamp <= a mid-run mtime
itemTest substitution for BOTH {files} and {name} incl. basename-alternation: tests/parser_test.go => parser_test
both runTest and runVerify append to evidence.jsonl and journal

MUST: adapter/evidence.ts MUST validate per-kind required fields when it WRITES/READS an EvidenceRecord (the §2 merged-union schema deliberately requires only the shared fields; a verify record missing startedMs/head/green/scopes must be rejected, not silently treated as fresh). This closes the Finding-4/5 chain from the Phase 1 gate.

runnerRules (the classifyFailure DATA) MUST ship tight, anchored regexes tested against real runner output (conductor/docs/RUNNER-DISCOVERY.md) so an unrelated crash containing an assertion token, or an in-scope missing-module line beside an unrelated error, is not mis-binned. classifyFailure's text-only causality is a known Phase-1 limitation the rule-data quality bounds.

adapter/evidence.ts MUST relativize absolute cwd-prefixed paths in captured stderr BEFORE calling core.classifyFailure. Real Node v26 ESM emits `Cannot find module '/abs/.../src/x.ts' imported from /abs/.../tests/x.test.mjs` (absolute), and this repo itself is ESM — an absolute specifier never matches a repo-relative fileScope glob, so a legal greenfield red would misclassify as `error` (illegal) and the item would die. 6.1 knows the cwd; strip it. TEST with a real ESM fixture emitting absolute paths, not only the CJS `../src/x.ts` shape.
